Topics to cover:
1. Limits of Multivariable Functions
2. Multivariable Taylor Expansions
3. Tangent Planes and Linear Approximations
category_note: multivariable-calculus is a provisional category: upstream has no dedicated category, while partial derivatives live under derivatives/.

notes.writer: Provisional category. 3 figure briefs. Link to sibling tangent-plane article is an unpublished batch dependency.
notes.illustrator: 3 figures (reading order). F1 two-path diagram; F2 epsilon-delta disc and epsilon-band; F3 exact contour map of xy^2/(x^2+y^4) plus a profile at y=0.6 (a 3D sheet was rejected for hidden-surface artifacts).
notes.reviewer: Mathematical/editorial/SVG-structural gates PASS. Mandatory visual-inspection gate NOT_RUN (no image-capable model in environment); Chrome headless rendered all 3 PNGs without error. Remote persistence verified after commit.

notes.writer: Provisional category. 3 figure briefs. General Peano theorem stated with reference; quadratic case proved. Sibling tangent-plane link is an unpublished batch dependency.
notes.illustrator: 3 figures (reading order): section along h=(1,1) with f, P1, P2; corrected flat-bottomed crater for e^(-1/(x^2+y^2)) — the brief said 'bump', but f(0,0)=0 and f>0 elsewhere — surface plus section; level curves of the three quadratic forms.
notes.reviewer: Math/editorial/SVG-structural gates PASS. One wording fix: 'bump near the origin' -> 'rise of the function away from the origin'. Visual-inspection gate NOT_RUN (no image-capable model). Remote persistence verified after commit.

notes.writer: Provisional category. 4 figure briefs. Continuous-partials sufficient condition and level-surface normal proved in article. Sibling Taylor link is an unpublished batch dependency.
notes.illustrator: 4 figures (reading order): sign sectors and three radial sections for xy/sqrt(x^2+y^2); tangent plane and normal; quadratic error of the linear approximation along the displacement (a radial section of the cone is exactly straight); sphere, tangent plane, gradient and curve.
